title: Continuity of the Jacobian √det(DF*∘DF) of a C¹ map on an open set (supplied step 5)
statement: Let m, P ∈ ℕ, let D ⊆ ℝ^m be open and let F : ℝ^m → ℝ^P be a map that is C¹ on D (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F D). Then the function w ↦ √det(DF(w)*∘DF(w)) is continuous on D. Here DF(w) = fderiv ℝ F w, DF(w)* is its Hilbert-space adjoint ℝ^P → ℝ^m, det is the determinant of the endomorphism DF(w)*∘DF(w) of ℝ^m (ContinuousLinearMap.det), and √ is Real.sqrt.
lean_statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (F : Euclid m → Euclid P) (D : Set (Euclid m)), IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F D → ContinuousOn (fun w => Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ F w).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ F w).det)) D
